info.name: Twitch Emotes External
info.author: Ali Digitali, SpeedyFolf, & Google Gemini
info.description: Twitch emotes will show up in the chat when you type their name (just as on twitch.tv). This is a slave resource or emote pack which holds Twitch browser extension (7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ) emote images.
